text:
The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

In the narrative provided, the melody serves as a powerful motif, functioning much like the heart itself. Just as the heart is the central organ that circulates life and connects every part of the body, the melody circulates through the community, connecting every character’s story. It beats in the background of their lives, appearing in unexpected places like a whistler or a distant radio, ensuring that no one is isolated. The melody acts as the rhythmic pulse of the community, knitting their shared experiences together into a cohesive fabric, proving that even in silence or separation, the same vital song binds them all.
